annotation.summary_en: A compilation sketch featuring a village with a questionable name, a convoluted trip to a hardware store, and a medieval rescue gone wrong.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: This sketch is a compilation of several humorous scenarios. In one segment, a man suffers from a severe hangover after a night of heavy drinking, rejecting his wife's offers of vodka and beer until she offers a kiss. Another segment features a medieval parody where a knight in full armor attempts to rescue a princess (played by a man in drag) chained to a wall. Upon hearing that the location is so remote that no one can hear her screams, the knight decides to take advantage of the situation himself. In a retail satire, a customer navigates an absurdly bureaucratic hardware store where every specific request (manual vs. automatic wash, white vs. colored clothes) requires moving to a different department managed by a new employee. A recurring road trip segment follows two men driving to Meghri to smuggle a car, who stop in a village called 'Gomikavan' to mock an old villager and his wife (both played by men in drag) about the village's name. The compilation also includes a kidnapping subplot involving a blonde woman in a car who threatens her captors with her father's connections to human rights defenders, ending in a chaotic village yard confrontation.
